name: @clawx/moe-principal-assistant
description: ClawX plugin: digital admin assistant persona, templates, and form-payload builders for primary-school principals in Trinidad & Tobago. Stub — drafts and form payloads are produced locally; no live form submission. Composes with @clawx/microsoft-graph (Outlook) and @clawx/whisper-asr (dictation).
//doc-tools-runtime-deps: The document.* tools in doc-tools.mjs depend on pdf-parse, mammoth, xlsx, docx, and sharp. These live in the root package.json dependencies (except sharp, which ships as an Electron dep). All five are already in EXTRA_BUNDLED_PACKAGES in scripts/openclaw-bundle-config.mjs, so they are copied into resources/openclaw/node_modules when electron-builder packages. Do NOT remove them from that list — dependency-class-auditor will fail the build.
